name: Spiked Heart
source:
Spike is just a cat like any other, until the local fairy came to visit and told him to find his true love, or else. Is it just a coincidence that the fairy looks exactly like Cereza? Can Spike find his true love? Why does the game look so shitty? Many questions  in this life have no answer.

[From [url=https://lunafromthemoon.itch.io/spiked-heart-demo] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
斯派克和其他猫一样只是一只猫，直到当地的仙女来拜访并告诉他去寻找他的真爱，否则。仙女长得和塞雷萨一模一样，难道只是巧合吗？斯派克能找到他的真爱吗？为什么游戏看起来这么垃圾？今生的许多问题都没有答案。

[来自[url=https://lunafromthemoon.itch.io/spiked-heart-demo] itch.io[/url]]
